input_mode.description: Input method: libvirt, vmx, vddk, disk, ova, libvirtxml.

input_uri.description: Connection URI for the input hypervisor (e.g., vpx://... for VMware, qemu:///system for local libvirt).

output_mode.description: Output method: libvirt, local, qemu, rhv, rhv-upload, openstack, vdsm.

output_storage.description: Storage target: pool UUID for libvirt, directory path for local, storage domain for rhv-upload, cinder volume type for openstack.

guest_source.description: Name of the libvirt domain to convert, or path to disk/VMX file depending on input mode.

output_guest_name.description: Optional new name for the converted guest. Empty string preserves original name.

bridge_mappings.description: List of network bridge mappings. Items are strings in 'source:target' format for --bridge option.

mac_mappings.description: List of MAC address mappings. Items are strings in 'mac:type:target' format for --mac option.

bandwidth_limit.description: Network bandwidth limit in bps (e.g., '10M'). Supported by some input transports.

disk_format.description: Output disk format (e.g., 'qcow2', 'raw'). Empty string uses input format.

compressed.description: If true, compresses the output qcow2 file (-oo compressed).

customizations.description: List of virt-customize commands to apply during conversion (e.g., --firstboot-command, --hostname).

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose debugging output (-v, --verbose).

quiet.description: If true, disables progress bars and unnecessary output (-q, --quiet).
